mechanism: Erythromycin inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, reducing methadone metabolism and increasing plasma concentrations, while methadone may prolong QT interval and erythromycin also carries QT-prolongation risk.
action: Monitor for methadone toxicity signs; consider QTc monitoring via ECG; dose adjustment of methadone may be necessary; consider alternative antibiotic with lower interaction potential.
